objective: Prove the dissonance floor W >= |chi|/2 and its consequences for growth (P0-P2), and run GROW-r on K_2-K_5 for r = 1-4 (P3).
status: Proved 2026-11-10 (by hand; the learner computed; pre-registered): W = violated lines + E + |D|/2 >= |chi|/2 in every state and law, so a sphere's flat state is at its floor and one grown atom (a torus, floor 0) is the only amount of growth that allows resolution, each further atom adding one unit no learning removes. Computed on K_2-K_6: a learner that grows only when no sequence of at most r steps lowers W grows at the dissonance at once; with r >= 3 it grows once and resolves in 3 sign changes, with r <= 2 it overgrows and never resolves.
title: A learner that grows only when stuck
